errors.text_span: 该饼图显示了动词视角下汉语性别表征研究中女性动词的语义域分布。图表中共有 21 个切片，每个切片代表一个语义类别。
errors.evidence: The figure does not show a single pie chart with 21 slices. It shows a primary pie chart and a secondary, exploded pie chart that provides a different breakdown of some categories. The description fails to capture this two-part structure.
The figure displays 20 unique categories in total across the two charts (19 in the legend plus the '其他' category). The description incorrectly states there are 21.
The category with the value 15.1% is labeled '争斗' (Struggle), not '收获' (Harvest). '收获' does not appear in the figure.
The color for the '表情' (Expression) slice is a reddish-pink, not '青色' (cyan).
The color for the '判断' (Judgment) slice is light blue, not '红色' (red).
The value 9.85% corresponds to the category '方位改变' (Positional Change). The category '帮助' (Help) has a value of 2.93%.
The category with the value 6.72% is labeled '物态事态' (State of things), not '陈述' (Statement). '陈述' does not appear in the figure.
The color for the '交通' (Transportation) slice is a dusty brown/taupe, not '天蓝色' (sky blue).
The color for the '经贸' (Trade) slice is light blue/cyan, not '浅灰色' (light gray).
The label is '社交' (Social), not '社会' (Society). The color is light blue, not '灰色' (gray).
The category with the value 14.57% is labeled '司法' (Judicial), not '生活' (Life). '生活' is part of the '生活工作' category in the main chart but not a standalone category with this value.
The category with the value 10.98% is labeled '文教' (Culture/Education), not '文本' (Text). '文本' does not appear in the figure.
The category with the value 0.27% is labeled '际遇' (Encounter), not '立场改变' (Change of stance). '立场改变' does not appear in the figure.
The category with the value 2.93% is labeled '帮助' (Help), not '律法' (Law). '律法' does not appear in the figure.

errors.text_span: 切片似乎按照大小递减的顺序列出。
errors.evidence: This refers to the order in the description's list, not the visual arrangement in the chart. The slices in neither of the two pie charts are ordered by size.
The description hallucinates several category labels that do not exist in the chart, including '收获' (Harvest), '陈述' (Statement), '生活' (Life), '文本' (Text), '立场改变' (Change of stance), and '律法' (Law).
